board.name: Indiana Physician Assistant Committee and Medical Licensing Board of Indiana, Indiana Professional Licensing Agency

ce.reason: Renewal requires evidence of current NCCPA certification; the state sets no hour count.

notes.text: The two hour opioid prescribing CE tied to the Indiana controlled substance registration expired July 1, 2025.

agreement.text: A written collaborative agreement with an Indiana physician is submitted to the board; amendments are resubmitted, and the board and committee are notified within 15 days when it ends. A new collaborating physician reviews at least 10% of charts with a prescription in the first year, for every PA however long they have practiced.

unverified: Whether the board must approve the collaborative agreement before practice begins (the statute lets the PA proceed unless the board denies it; the current Indiana Administrative Code text was not loaded)

board.name: Indiana State Board of Nursing, Indiana Professional Licensing Agency

cycleYears.reason: RN licenses expire October 31 of each odd-numbered year.
RN licenses expire October 31 of each odd-numbered year: every two years.

notes.text: Indiana's APRN credential is prescriptive authority; NPs who do not prescribe practice on the RN license.
First renewal: authority granted less than 12 months before expiry needs no CE; 12 months or more, 15 contact hours including 4 in pharmacology.

certificationInLieu.note: The board's audit page accepts national certification in lieu of the 30 contact hours; IC 25-23-1-19.7 and 848 IAC 5-1-3 state the hours and certification as separate requirements, so this is not yet settled.

topics.label: Pharmacology, part of the 30 contact hours

unverified: Whether national certification stands in for the APRN contact hours (the board's audit page says so; the statute and rule list both)

agreement.text: Every NP practices in collaboration with a licensed practitioner, shown by a practice agreement or hospital privileges. A written collaborative practice agreement is needed for prescriptive authority, and a current signed and dated copy goes in with each renewal.
